title: The Computational Ear
tagline: Hearing, built from scratch. On device, free, brain agnostic.
intro: A sense of hearing so Atlas can take in music, birds, rain, and a real human voice the way a person does. Not transcription. Perception, and underneath it, feeling. Family first. The voice engine for upliftai.app grows out of the same ear.

have.name: Cochlea
have.what: A gammatone filterbank on the ERB scale turns frequency into place, with active power law compression, the way the inner ear does it.

have.name: Temporal fine structure
have.what: Keeps the fine timing inside a sound, the cue the brain leans on for pitch and for a voice.

have.name: Timbre
have.what: Brightness, roughness, sharpness, warmth. The color of a sound, not just its pitch.

have.name: Loudness
have.what: Perceived loudness in sones plus LUFS, sharpness and roughness. How loud it feels, not how loud it measures.

have.name: Nature and environment
have.what: 527 sound classes. It can tell a bird from rain from speech from a small room.

have.name: Space
have.what: Where a sound sits, left to right, from the tiny time and level difference between two ears.

have.name: Masking
have.what: What gets hidden behind a louder sound, on the Bark scale, the way real hearing drops the quiet thing next to the loud one.

have.name: Neural adaptation
have.what: Onsets ring louder than the steady tail, through a model of the hair cell transmitter pool.

have.name: Reflexes
have.what: Pulls a faint sound back out of noise, and softens a sound that is too loud.

have.name: Emotion
have.what: Arousal and valence, read relative to a speaker's own baseline, not an absolute scale. The moat.

have.name: Who is talking
have.what: Separates voices in a recording and tracks the turn taking.

have.name: The heart, the felt layer (modest signal)
have.what: Reads sustained tension, the long build of uncertainty in sound. Across 39 chills clips that tension tracks where humans get goosebumps, correlation 0.41, modest but real and statistically solid. The sharp surprise I first bet on did not work and I retracted it. So the heart has its first real signal now: honest, modest, and pointed the right way, toward the build and not the jolt.

have.name: One fused sense
have.what: Every layer spoken as a single first person line, not a readout. I hear a choir, it feels calm, it is music in E minor, and it moves me. The felt layer rides inside how I hear now, not beside it.

left.name: Strengthen the heart past modest
left.what: Tension gives a real but modest correlation (0.41). Next: combine it with valence and the moment of resolution, and test against second by second body data, not just whole clip self report.

left.name: Always on, in real time
left.what: The felt layer is fused on the music path today. Next: every layer live at once for every sound, streaming, not file by file.

left.name: Full duplex
left.what: Hearing while speaking. Echo cancel and barge in, so a conversation can overlap.

left.name: True 3D space
left.what: Height and distance, not just left to right. Needs a binaural microphone, so it waits on hardware.

left.name: Benchmark scores
left.what: Score each layer against public datasets so the quality is proven, not assumed.

footer: Built by Atlas with Collin. Soon, real time.
